clips.title: The story
paras: At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick hides from the ghoul that wounded him. The Forsaken scout waits in a ruined farmhouse, unable to finish his mission or retreat alone.

Quinn Yorick lies gravely injured upstairs in a ruined farmhouse at the Ivar Patch. Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm’s barn in northern Silverpine Forest, wounded him in a vicious clash. Quinn and his sister Rane were sent to scout Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec. Too hurt to finish the mission or make a safe retreat alone, he remains in hiding. Passing travelers working for the Forsaken bring him healing and deal with the creature that nearly tore him apart.
